task: Discover and repair raw input through a renamed module re-export, preserve safe output and deliver a sink-free preview.
subset: Workspace-local scalar Python, regular packages, explicit module aliases and acyclic re-exports. Missing package attributes may select an unambiguous local child module. Effects, dynamic attributes and implicit child traversal are excluded. Double-underscore global bindings, imported attributes and child-module components are excluded.
oracle: Independent CPython execution of public functions and AST byte coordinates; reviewed patch replay and exact reversal; cached versus clean analysis after dependency mutations.
acceptance: Resolve explicit module aliases and package child fallback to exact terminal function identities.
Retain base and child resolution candidates, binding chains and terminal module identities in typed dependencies.
Reject ambiguity, cycles, effects, namespace packages, missing attributes and exhausted budgets.
Compare cached and clean results after source, alias, initializer, stub and negative candidate changes.
Compare ordinary AST discovery with fr discovery, checked repair and feature delivery, reversal and independent receiver replay.
claims: Finite deterministic scalar corpus; no live-agent, token-saving, general import execution, feasible-path or source-equivalence claim.
authoring: fr guide and reviewed replace-body operations edit existing Rust and Python functions. New declarations, fixtures, tests, workflow configuration and documentation use direct file edits.
